name: Rez Tax
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Reina Roja: Freedom Fighter, System Update 2021's Anarch identity, whose first piece of ice the Corp rezzes each turn costs 1[credit] more. On Free Spirit's frame, its identity swapped, at six influence of fifteen. Tranche 8 Stage 11n. Tranche 8 Stage 11r: two Stimhack for its two Katorga Breakout, a run event for a run event, run on nine hosted credits and ended in core damage nobody can prevent; Side Quest, Free Spirit and Pay as You Go keep Katorga Breakout. FFG F1 Stage 1 (Revised Core Set): two Force of Nature, decoder for decoder, for its two Utae; and two Morning Star, which breaks every barrier subroutine for a credit, for its two Stargate. Each card given up is still in another deck. FFG F1 Stage 2: two Singularity for its two Take a Dive, an event for an event, a remote run that trashes the server's root instead of breaching it. Another deck keeps Take a Dive. FFG F1 Stage 5: two Spinal Modem, a console for a console, for its The Toolbox and one of its two Cyberfeeder, suffering core damage whenever a trace succeeds during a run; both are still in other decks, and the deck now spends no influence. Kitara Stage 6a: two By Any Means for two Finality. Two Black Hat and White Hat for two Xanadu and a Marrow (FFG F3 Stage 10b). Acacia (Kitara Stage 11a) in for a Cyberfeeder and a Marrow. Flashpoint Stage 27 swapped two Ice Carvers for Credit Crash. Lunar Stage 1 (FFG F8): Q-Coherence Chip and Rachel Beckman for two Time Bombs, which other decks keep. Two Vamp take Scrubber's place. Two Quest Completed take Chastushka's place. Two Data Leak Reversal take Liberated Account's place.
